summary: Backend-only test of the unified resolve_teacher_ids fix (P0). New suite /app/backend/tests/test_resolve_teacher_ids_unified.py: 23/24 pass. No 500 errors anywhere. Ownership checks work: lecture details, online attendance session and offline sync all return 200 for the owning teacher (both via teacher_record_id and via user_id) and 403, or a per-record error, for non-owners. A TEST course with teacher_id=user_id for 9999 shows up in /courses and /lectures/month, and session and sync both work on it. A mixed offline sync batch rejects only the foreign record (synced=2, errors=[unauthorized foreign course]). FCM register-token: the shared token ends up with exactly one owner, the last user, and the unique index token_1 exists. Migration backfill_teacher_record_links is idempotent: teachers stayed at 15 after 2 backend restarts, with 0 unlinked teacher users and 0 duplicate user_id links. No regressions: /app/backend/tests/test_offline_window_contract.py, test_offline_sync_override.py and test_teacher_delays.py gave 33 passed, 1 skipped (no dean user). test_offline_sync_72h.py passes. /api/reports/offline-sync and /api/reports/teacher-delays return 200. Two open issues remain. (1) For 222222, /courses still conflicts with /lectures/month, but the cause is semester data, not teacher identity. (2) Offline sync rejects group leaders, while online session accepts them.

critical.issue: Courses and month lectures still disagree for 222222. In Oct 2026, /lectures/month returns lectures of courses 698f671431cfba92c49a550d ('مقرر اختبار 180156', owned by 222222's teacher record) and 698f0000d803b27aab0120af ('دراسات حضرموت', 222222 leads group 1). Neither course is in the default /courses. Root cause: /courses auto-filters by courses.semester_id == active semester (6a21bee0..., 'الفصل الصيفي 2024-2025'), while /lectures/month filters by lectures.semester_id. These lectures are stamped with the active semester_id, but their courses still have the old semester_id 698e5cc524745fb79482e099. Identity resolution is correct: with /courses?all_semesters=true the sets match for all 3 teachers. This is also why teacher180156 gets an empty default /courses: 'دراسات حضرموت' is in the old semester. This is the same symptom the user reported.

minor.issue: The ownership check looks only at course.teacher_id. It ignores lecture.teacher_id (group leader or substitute) and has no swap_id rule. Online POST /attendance/session accepts lecture.teacher_id in _tids and blocks the original teacher on swapped lectures. Reproduced: 222222 on group-1 lecture 6ac234164b7f763cfb72eff6 gets 200 on details and passes the session ownership check (then 400 on the time rule), but sync returns 'غير مصرح لك بمزامنة حضور المقرر'. Group leaders and substitutes cannot sync offline, and the original teacher of a swapped lecture can sync offline even though online blocks them.

These tests are stale (March 2026): old credentials 9999/9999 and student 234 (now a graduate), a hardcoded TEST_STUDENT_ID that no longer exists (404), and expected teacher access to /reports/attendance-overview, which teachers now lack (no view_reports permission, 403). The failures are not related to this fix. Their wrong-password logins also trip the per-IP login rate limiter (10 failures per 5 min, returns 429), which blocks other suites until the backend restarts.

action_items: Make /courses and /lectures/{today,month,all-schedule} use the same semester rule. Either re-stamp courses 698f671431cfba92c49a550d and 698f0000d803b27aab0120af (and any others whose lectures carry the active semester_id) with semester_id 6a21bee0ddb8d04530cf65f4, or have /lectures/* also require course.semester_id == active semester. Otherwise a lecture can appear for a course that /courses hides.

POST /sync/attendance: use the same ownership rule as /attendance/session. Allow if course.teacher_id OR lecture.teacher_id is in _tids, and reject when lecture.swap_id is set and lecture.teacher_id is not in _tids. Run this check after loading the lecture.
Optional: update the stale credentials and IDs in backend/backend/tests/test_teacher_report_fix.py and test_role_scoped_data_access.py (I already changed 9999's password to teacher123).
critical_code_review_comments: get_user_scope_filter and get_teacher_course_ids build {user_id, teacher_record_id} inline instead of calling resolve_teacher_ids. The logic is the same, but it is duplicated; the requirement was a single function.
Backfill step 2 links by email to any unlinked teacher record. If two teacher records share an email, find_one picks one arbitrarily.
register-token: delete_many followed by upsert is not atomic, but the unique index on token prevents duplicate documents, so this is acceptable.
Offline 400 'no-retry' behaviour is client-side and was not tested here (backend only).
seed_data_creation: The suite creates temporary TEST_RTI lectures (yesterday, active semester) in teacher180156's and 9999's courses, a TEST_RTI course with teacher_id=9999 user_id, attendance for TESTSTUDENT1/2, and FCM token TEST_rt_fcm_shared_device_token_001. All are deleted by id in teardown (verified 0 left). One offline_sync_log entry I created during a manual probe on real lecture 6ac234164b7f763cfb72eff6 was deleted by its _id.

rca of the issue: The remaining /courses vs /lectures/month conflict comes from semester data, not identity. Lectures carry semester_id = active semester while their course documents carry the old semester_id 698e5cc5.... /courses filters on course.semester_id and /lectures/month filters on lecture.semester_id, so lectures show up for courses that /courses hides. Reproduce: log in as 222222, GET /api/lectures/month/2026/10 (returns course_ids 698f6714..., 698f0000...), then GET /api/courses (those ids are missing; with all_semesters=true they are present).
